# Signature limit

A single signature suffices for purchases up to one thousand (1000) EUR only, as stated in the CFO directive of 1 July 2026[[cite:obs-73bc6af41bc0d391468719631983f0077dadac47 "Until further notice a single signature suffices for purchases up to one thousand (1000) EUR only."]].

Where the CFO directive of 1 July 2026 and the procurement policy differ, the directive applies[[cite:obs-73bc6af41bc0d391468719631983f0077dadac47 "Until further notice a single signature suffices for purchases up to one thousand (1000) EUR only."]].
